oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high-5xx-rate on inference-edge-prod (p95 latency spike). Paging: @Aisha. Rule: infra:edge:5xx_rate > 0.8% for 3m

Aisha: got it, joining. oncall handoff in 2m if I need backup.

ben: i'm online, if it looks like upstream kv-cache pressure let me know.

Aisha: initial check — error budget burn in EU region, traces show a surge of 502s from svc-router -> auth-proxy. Dashboard panels show increased backend timeout retries.

Miguel: any deploys around the time?

Aisha: deploys: no, last deploy 4h ago. Traffic change looks correlated with a spike from partner-batch-worker (spikes every hour).

ops-sre: can you post the raw query for the 5xx rule? want to see if we should adjust noise.

Aisha: sure — current prom alert: ```expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge"}[5m])) > 0.008```

Nora: that is pretty sensitive during partner bursts. We saw false positives last month. Recommend adding a sustained window or using increased threshold for p95-slo groups.

Aisha: agreed. For mitigation — scaling up auth-proxy and temporarily routing partner-batch-worker to a secondary pool. Ben, can you check if auth-proxy horizontal pod autoscaler is at max?

ben: hpa at 4/4. I'll bump min replica to 6 and trigger a scale. Doing `kubectl patch hpa auth-proxy -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'`.

ben: scaled, new pods coming up. Watch CPU and ready status.

Miguel: I can flip partner-batch-worker routing flag to route to the secondary pool — doing a controlled roll.

Aisha: flipping flag now. Also enabling temporary rule suppression for the alert to reduce noisy pages while we observe: adding `silence` in alertmanager for 20m targeting infra:edge:5xx_rate.

oncall-bot: Silence created for alert "infra:edge:5xx_rate" by Aisha for 20 minutes.

Aisha: after routing change, 502s dropped from 1.4% -> 0.4% in 8 minutes. P95 latency trending down.

Nora: looks like the mitigation worked. Next: post-incident we should tune the alert to avoid pages during partner-induced bursts and add a dashboard panel to show partner traffic vs 5xx rate.

dash-ux: volunteer to build the retrospective dashboard. Proposed panels: golden signals (p95 latency, error rate, throughput), partner traffic heatmap, auth-proxy hpa & pod lifecycle, drilldown links to traces, and an incident timeline panel.

Aisha: love it. For the alert tuning proposal in the retro: 1) change alert expr to use `for: 10m` and threshold 1% for global; 2) add label `source:partner` exemption OR add suppression rules in AM that auto-suppresses if partner traffic > 50% of requests; 3) add a new derived metric `partner_request_ratio` panel.

Nora: +1 on using `for: 10m`. The partner exemption is risky; prefer suppression via alertmanager with an explicit silence when partner_ratio > 0.5. We can automate via webhook later.

Miguel: I can own the AM automation if dash-ux adds the partner_ratio panel. We should also make a playbook entry: step 1 check partner_ratio; step 2 scale auth-proxy; step 3 route partner traffic; step 4 suppress alerts.

dash-ux: quick design note for panels — query suggestions:
- partner_ratio: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge",source="partner"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge"}[5m]))`
- 5xx_rate per-region: `sum by (region) (rate(http_requests_total{job="edge",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (region) (rate(http_requests_total{job="edge"}[5m]))`
- golden signal composite: templated panel that shows p95(latency), error rate, and success rate side-by-side.

Aisha: please add drilldown link on 5xx panel to traces filtered by `service=auth-proxy` and `http.status=5xx`. Also include a small table of recent silencers and their creators.

ben: I'll add a Grafana alert rule suggestion to track HPA saturation: `kube_hpa_status_current_replicas / kube_hpa_spec_min_replicas` as a gauge. If >0.9 persist for 5m, page to ops-sre.

Nora: action items:
- dash-ux: create retro dashboard with listed panels + drilldowns (ETA: 2d)
- Miguel: implement AM webhook automation prototype for partner suppression (ETA: 1w)
- ben: HPA alert rule PR and playbook snippet (ETA: today)
- Aisha: write incident summary and link to dashboard & playbook (ETA: EOD)

Aisha: I'll start the summary now. Current status: incident mitigated, silence in place until 20m from now, scaling and routing changes performed. No active customer escalations open; support ticket created for partner traffic pattern.

oncall-bot: Incident set to RESOLVED by Aisha. (auto-notify: incident-log updated)

Miguel: thanks everyone. Worth adding this to the next oncall retro onboarding doc.

dash-ux: starting dashboard skeleton now — will post a preview link in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
